entries.canonical_text: It just doesn't sit right with me to pay for redelivery. My husband and I are both out of the house for work, so for packages where I can choose, I pick a day and time when I know I'll be home. But once, I chose a morning time slot and the package didn't come. I went out to take care of an errand, and when I got back, there was a delivery notice. Many packages don't let you choose a delivery time, either, so you don't know ahead of time when they'll arrive. Before charging us, I want them to first do something about showing up at the time we chose and telling us when the package will arrive. The delivery workers are probably having a hard time because they're short-staffed, and maybe it can't be helped. But I can't accept having to pay for that. Am I wrong to feel that way?
